design: single matched pilot, bundle comparison; not a replicated causal evaluation of components
expected_followup: fresh session per arm with prior files available; upgraded retrieves saved memory; baseline may reuse ordinary notes
telemetry: Codex exec turn.completed; retain cached input separately; not measured dollar charges

visual_quality: annotation conveys interpretation not only decoration
component_evidence: actual MCP call log and artifact hashes
source findings tied to named decisions

limitations: One run per arm per phase; stochastic variation not controlled by replication.
Concurrent initial runs make elapsed time descriptive, not a precise latency benchmark.
Enhanced instructions and tool schemas add context; token counts include this overhead.
Baseline may reuse ordinary notes, scripts and artifacts during cold restart; it is not forced to replay a long conversation.
Bundled treatment comparison cannot isolate the causal contribution of memory from every other workflow change.
CLI token totals are telemetry, not dollar charges or quota accounting.
